sentences.en: From The New York Times, this is The Interview.
sentences.zh: 来自《纽约时报》，这里是《访谈》。

sentences.en: I'm Lulu Garcia Navarro.
sentences.zh: 我是露露·加西亚-纳瓦罗。

sentences.en: One of the things I often get asked about this job is, what is the hardest thing about interviewing famous people?
sentences.zh: 关于这份工作，人们经常问我的问题之一是：采访名流最难的是什么？

sentences.en: And the answer is both obvious and a real challenge.
sentences.zh: 答案既显而易见，又是一个真正的挑战。

sentences.en: Many stars, and especially female stars, have experienced the ugly side of celebrity culture, which has made them wary about opening up.
sentences.zh: 许多明星，尤其是女明星，都经历过名人文化丑陋的一面，这让她们在敞开心扉时保持警惕。

sentences.en: That's also true for today's guest, Jennifer Lawrence.
sentences.zh: 今天的嘉宾詹妮弗·劳伦斯也是如此。

sentences.en: Lawrence had a heady start to her career, starring in two huge franchises, The Hunger Games and X-Men, and winning an Oscar for Silver Linings Playbook, all before she turned 23.
sentences.zh: 劳伦斯的职业生涯开局惊艳，主演了《饥饿游戏》和《X战警》两大巨作系列，并凭借《乌云背后的幸福线》赢得奥斯卡奖，这一切都在她23岁之前。

sentences.en: Off camera, the public couldn't seem to get enough of her offbeat humor and outspoken persona.
sentences.zh: 在镜头之外，公众似乎对她古怪的幽默感和直言不讳的性格永远看不够。

sentences.en: Privately, though, Lawrence told me she was feeling pretty beat up and was waiting for the inevitable backlash.
sentences.zh: 然而私底下，劳伦斯告诉我她觉得自己饱受打击，并正等待着不可避免的反噬。

sentences.en: And it came, in waves of negative attention and headlines about whether she was too much, too annoying, too outspoken, a fake.
sentences.zh: 它确实来了，伴随着一波又一波的负面关注和头条新闻，讨论她是否太过火、太烦人、太直言不讳、是个假货。

sentences.en: So after almost a decade of being in the limelight in 2018,
sentences.zh: 因此，在聚光灯下生活了近十年后，在2018年，

sentences.en: Lawrence took a step back from acting, fired her agency, and did some soul-searching.
sentences.zh: 劳伦斯退出了演艺界，解雇了她的经纪公司，并进行了一些灵魂深处的反思。

sentences.en: And now, as I found out when I sat down with her, she is demonstrably different.
sentences.zh: 而现在，正如我与她坐下来交谈时所发现的那样，她明显变得不同了。

sentences.en: We talked in advance of her new film,
sentences.zh: 我们在她的新片上映前进行了交谈，

sentences.en: Lynn Ramsey's Die, My Love.
sentences.zh: 林恩·拉姆塞的《死吧，我的爱》。

sentences.en: She plays a young mother losing her mind in rural Montana.
sentences.zh: 她在片中饰演一位在蒙大拿州乡村精神崩溃的年轻母亲。

sentences.en: Lawrence told me her character, Grace, brought up a lot of complicated feelings because of her own struggles with postpartum symptoMs.
sentences.zh: 劳伦斯告诉我，由于她自己与产后症状的斗争，她的角色格蕾丝勾起了许多复杂的情感。

sentences.en: We started, though, talking about how this project came to her, which involved a very famous director and his very private book club.
sentences.zh: 不过，我们首先谈到的是这个项目是如何找到她的，这涉及一位非常著名的导演和他非常私密的读书俱乐部。

sentences.en: Here's my conversation with Jennifer Lawrence.
sentences.zh: 以下是我与詹妮弗·劳伦斯的对话。

sentences.en: Thank you so much for joining the interview.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢您参加这次访谈。

sentences.en: I'm so excited to talk.
sentences.zh: 我非常激动能进行交流。

sentences.en: Thanks for having me.
sentences.zh: 谢谢邀请我。

sentences.en: I want to talk about your new film because I have a lot of thoughts.
sentences.zh: 我想聊聊你的新电影，因为我有很多想法。

sentences.en: This film was adapted from a book by Ariana Harvitz, and Martin Scorsese was the one who wanted you to play this role after he read the book in his book club.
sentences.zh: 这部电影改编自阿里安娜·哈维茨的小说，马丁·斯科塞斯在读书俱乐部读完这本书后，指定让你来演这个角色。

sentences.en: I know.
sentences.zh: 我知道。

sentences.en: When you reached out, what did he say?
sentences.zh: 当你收到联系时，他说什么了？

sentences.en: It was very complimentary, so I would be remiss to repeat it.
sentences.zh: 赞美之词非常多，如果我复述出来就太不像话了。

sentences.en: Please repeat it.
sentences.zh: 请复述一下吧。

sentences.en: No, it was very nice, but he was just like— I think, first of all, he said that I should read it and that I would be good in it, and I read it.
sentences.zh: 不，这非常好，但他只是——我想，首先，他说我应该读读看，而且我在里面会演得很好，然后我就读了。

sentences.en: I had just had my first baby, and so it was a lot.
sentences.zh: 我刚刚生了第一个孩子，所以这有很多情绪。

sentences.en: It was really overwhelming.
sentences.zh: 真的让人应接不暇。

sentences.en: I read it in one sitting, but I was actually in a really good place in my postpartum journey.
sentences.zh: 我一口气读完了，但实际上我在产后历程中处于一个非常好的状态。

sentences.en: I didn't struggle in the kind of classic postpartum way.
sentences.zh: 我没有经历那种传统的产后挣扎。

sentences.en: I bonded right away with my son, and so I think because of that, I was able to allow my mind to kind of go to those darker places.
sentences.zh: 我和我的儿子立刻建立起了亲密感，所以我想正因如此，我才能让自己的思维去到那些更黑暗的地方。

sentences.en: I think if I was in a dark place and I read it, I would be too afraid of it, and so it's kind of like turning all the lights on
sentences.zh: 我想如果我当时处于黑暗的境地而去读它，我会对它感到过于害怕，所以这有点像把所有的灯都打开

sentences.en: and looking at the monster under the bed or something.
sentences.zh: 然后看着床底下的怪物之类的东西。

sentences.en: Before we move on, who is in Marty Scorsese's book club?
sentences.zh: 在我们继续之前，马蒂·斯科塞斯的读书俱乐部里都有谁？

sentences.en: I know.
sentences.zh: 我知道。

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: I mean— I could just ask.
sentences.zh: 我是说——我可以去问问。

sentences.en: I think you need to ask.
sentences.zh: 我觉得你需要去问问。

sentences.en: I mean, the worst he could say is, I don't feel like telling you.
sentences.zh: 我是说，他最糟糕的回答也就是，我不想告诉你。

sentences.en: Are you in a book club?
sentences.zh: 你参加读书俱乐部吗？

sentences.en: I'm in a soft book club.
sentences.zh: 我参加了一个佛系读书俱乐部。

sentences.en: We tried to make an official book, but we're just too different in our tastes.
sentences.zh: 我们曾试图建立一个正式的读书会，但我们的品味实在太不同了。

sentences.en: Back to the film, as I was watching it, it seemed to me sort of like this scream against the current elevation of domestic life
sentences.zh: 回到电影本身，当我观看它时，它在我看来有点像是在发出一种呐喊，反对当前将家庭生活

sentences.en: and perfect motherhood as sort of the pinnacle of female achievement.
sentences.zh: 和完美母职视为女性成就巅峰的崇高地位。

sentences.en: What is this film about for you?
sentences.zh: 对你来说，这部电影是关于什么的？

sentences.en: It kind of morphs for me.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，它一直在演变。

sentences.en: I think that it's definitely about somebody losing her identity and motherhood and rage at not just her husband, but the change of the relationship, the change of the love.
sentences.zh: 我认为它绝对是关于某人在母职中失去自我，以及不仅对丈夫、还有对关系的变化、对爱的变化的愤怒。

sentences.en: But what I really like about it is it's kind of—it's poetry.
sentences.zh: 但我真正喜欢它的是，它有点——它就像是诗歌。

sentences.en: There's not kind of a single way to look at it.
sentences.zh: 它并没有那种单一的视角。

sentences.en: There's like a statement and then breathing room for you to read into what the statement means.
sentences.zh: 它有一个论点，然后留出呼吸的空间，让你去解读这个论点意味着什么。

sentences.en: To you.
sentences.zh: 对你而言。

sentences.en: Everybody I talk to comes away with something different.
sentences.zh: 我交谈过的每个人都有着不同的感悟。

sentences.en: How do you view what grace your character is actually going through?
sentences.zh: 你如何看待你的角色格蕾丝实际正在经历的事情？

sentences.en: Because I've read reviews that say that she has postpartum depression.
sentences.zh: 因为我读过评论说她患有产后抑郁症。

sentences.en: I've read reviews that say that she, you know, is bipolar.
sentences.zh: 我读过评论说她，你知道的，患有双相情感障碍。

sentences.en: I've read reviews that say that she has psychosis.
sentences.zh: 我读过评论说她患有精神病。

sentences.en: I'm wondering, first of all, does it matter?
sentences.zh: 首先我想知道，这重要吗？

sentences.en: And then how you understood what she is experiencing.
sentences.zh: 然后你是如何理解她所经历的一切的。

sentences.en: That's another thing that kind of morphed for me and never really felt like one thing.
sentences.zh: 这也是对我来说不断演变且从未感觉是单一事物的另一件事。

sentences.en: I was pregnant.
sentences.zh: 我当时怀孕了。

sentences.en: I was in my second trimester.
sentences.zh: 我当时在孕中期。

sentences.en: When you were filming this?
sentences.zh: 在你拍这部电影的时候？

sentences.en: When I was filming this.
sentences.zh: 在我拍这部电影的时候。

sentences.en: And I think there were like—there were certain realities that I just—I couldn't like look at.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为有一些——有一些现实情况我只是——我无法去直面。

sentences.en: And I spoke to a postpartum specialist who told me that the number one cause of death in mothers in the first year is suicide.
sentences.zh: 我和一位产后专家交谈过，她告诉我，产妇在第一年死亡的第一大原因是自杀。

sentences.en: And that obviously went into our thinking about the ending, the foreSt.
sentences.zh: 这显然影响了我们对结局、对那片森林的构思。

sentences.en: What is the forest?
sentences.zh: 森林是什么？

sentences.en: What is the fire?
sentences.zh: 火灾是什么？

sentences.en: Do they find their way back to each other?
sentences.zh: 他们能找到重归于好的路吗？

sentences.en: What does all of it mean?
sentences.zh: 这一切意味着什么？

sentences.en: And so I think I saw the forest as more of like a cleansing.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为我把森林更多地看作是一种净化。

sentences.en: We should say at the end she walks into this burning foreSt.
sentences.zh: 我们应该说明，在最后她走进了这片燃烧的森林。

sentences.en: Are we supposed to do this?
sentences.zh: 我们本该这样做吗？

sentences.en: Am I going to like ruin the movie for everybody?
sentences.zh: 我会不会把电影对所有人的观感毁了？

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: You brought it up.
sentences.zh: 是你提起来的。

sentences.en: That's why I have to be clear on what it is.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么我必须弄清楚它到底是什么。

sentences.en: I guess I have like franchise paranoia, but maybe it's fine.
sentences.zh: 我想我有某种系列电影的偏执狂，但也许没关系。

sentences.en: Franchise paranoia.
sentences.zh: 系列电影偏执狂。

sentences.en: I think there's not going to be a franchise of this film, but who am I to say?
sentences.zh: 我想这部电影不会拍成一个系列，但谁又能说得准呢？

sentences.en: I would agree with you.
sentences.zh: 我同意你的看法。

sentences.en: And anyway, she is someone who is very—
sentences.zh: 无论如何，她是一个非常——

sentences.en: She's very—
sentences.zh: 她非常——

sentences.en: She's really depressed.
sentences.zh: 她真的很抑郁。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: She's really unhappy.
sentences.zh: 她很不开心。

sentences.en: She's really angry.
sentences.zh: 她真的很愤怒。

sentences.en: And I think the love that you have for your child, I think sometimes when—I think that she was so loSt.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为你对孩子的爱，我想有时候当——我觉得她是那么迷失。

sentences.en: That she felt like she was the only thing wrong with her baby and that she was the only thing that could ruin her child.
sentences.zh: 以至于她觉得自己是她孩子身上唯一的问题，而且她是唯一能毁掉她孩子的东西。

sentences.en: And when I watched it back after having my second child and actually experiencing postpartum depression, that was a really, really weird experience.
sentences.zh: 当我生完第二个孩子并真正经历产后抑郁症后回看这部电影时，那真是一种非常、非常奇特的体验。

sentences.en: I walked away with so many different opinions about it that I don't want to share because then I'll give up the whole movie and the allegories.
sentences.zh: 我从中得出了太多不同的见解，以至于我不想分享，因为那样我就把整部电影和寓意都剧透了。

sentences.en: Like, what am I doing?
sentences.zh: 天哪，我在干什么？

sentences.en: Well, let me ask you something else then.
sentences.zh: 好吧，那我问你点别的。

sentences.en: You just said you experienced postpartum depression after your second child.
sentences.zh: 你刚才说你在第二个孩子出生后经历了产后抑郁症。

sentences.en: Can you talk to me a little bit about what that looked like for you?
sentences.zh: 能跟我聊聊那对你来说是什么样的吗？

sentences.en: And I guess that must have been surprising perhaps because you—
sentences.zh: 我想这一定让你感到惊讶，因为你——

sentences.en: Yeah, because I was ready and I knew what I was doing and I felt more confident.
sentences.zh: 是的，因为我已经准备好了，我知道自己在做什么，而且我感到更有信心。

sentences.en: I just expected to feel the way I did with my first, which I feel like it should just be said.
sentences.zh: 我只是期望能有和我头胎时一样的感受，我觉得这一点应该说出来。

sentences.en: But I think postpartum is just a physical experience that happens to everybody.
sentences.zh: 但我认为产后只是一种发生在每个人身上的生理体验。

sentences.en: I mean, your hormones are doubling every day in your first trimester.
sentences.zh: 我是说，在你的孕早期，你的荷尔蒙每天都在成倍增长。

sentences.en: And then those hormones plummet after you have a baby.
sentences.zh: 然后在你生完孩子后，这些荷尔蒙急剧下降。

sentences.en: They plummet again when you wean.
sentences.zh: 当你断奶时，它们又会再次急剧下降。

sentences.en: And so my experience with my second was I just felt like a tiger was chasing me every day.
sentences.zh: 所以我怀老二时的经历是，我感觉每天都有一只老虎在追赶我。

sentences.en: I've had so much anxiety.
sentences.zh: 我有那么多的焦虑。

sentences.en: I had nonstop intrusive thoughts that I was just like at the whim of.
sentences.zh: 我有源源不断的侵入性想法，而我简直就像是它们的阶下囚。

sentences.en: They've like controlled me.
sentences.zh: 它们就像是在控制我。

sentences.en: Fear about your child, fear about yourself.
sentences.zh: 对孩子的恐惧，对自己的恐惧。

sentences.en: Yeah, it was fear about my child, just picturing every worst case scenario.
sentences.zh: 是的，那是对孩子的恐惧，脑海中不断浮现出每一个最坏的情况。

sentences.en: And then just doubting everything that I was doing, everything that, you know.
sentences.zh: 然后就是质疑我正在做的每一件事，你知道的每一件事。

sentences.en: And then I was already in therapy, but I got on a drug called Zerzovay and I took it for two weeks and it really helped me.
sentences.zh: 然后我已经在做心理治疗了，但我开始服用一种叫做Zerzovay的药，我吃了两周，它真的帮了我很大忙。

sentences.en: So if anybody is having postpartum Zerzovay, I'm not paid by them, but they could maybe throw me something.
sentences.zh: 所以如果任何人有产后问题去用Zerzovay，我没有收他们的广告费，但他们或许可以赞助我一点。

sentences.en: But that helped you.
sentences.zh: 但那确实帮到了你。

sentences.en: Yeah, I went on a pill that was designed for postpartum.
sentences.zh: 是的，我开始服用一种专为产后设计的药丸。

sentences.en: I took it for two weeks and it helped a lot.
sentences.zh: 我吃了两周，它起了很大作用。

sentences.en: I'm a parent myself and also someone who's suffered from mental illness, PTSD and other things.
sentences.zh: 我自己也是个父母，同时也是一个饱受精神疾病、创伤后应激障碍和其他问题折磨的人。

sentences.en: And so, you know, I was watching the film.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道的，我在看这部电影。

sentences.en: And again, I think what's really powerful about the film is that it can't speak to different things that people have experienced.
sentences.zh: 再次说明，我认为这部电影真正有力量的地方在于，它能触及人们经历过的不同事情。

sentences.en: There's the universality of, of course, anyone who's been a parent and a mother, but also just anyone who's struggled with their mental health.
sentences.zh: 这里面有着普遍性，当然是对任何当过父母和母亲的人而言，但也是对任何与心理健康作斗争的人而言。

sentences.en: Have you, other than that time of postpartum depression, struggled with mental health issues, things like that that helped you sort of understand the character a little better?
sentences.zh: 除了那段产后抑郁的时期，你是否还经历过精神健康问题，比如诸如此类的事情，它们曾帮助你更好地理解这个角色？

sentences.en: Yeah, I've struggled with anxiety for most of my life.
sentences.zh: 是的，我大半生都在与焦虑作斗争。

sentences.en: And anxiety's close friend is normally depression because they, by the end of the day, are so exhausted from the, like,
sentences.zh: 焦虑的密友通常是抑郁，因为到了一天结束时，你已经精疲力竭，因为那种

sentences.en: adrenal burnout that you just kind of plummet and get really sad from that.
sentences.zh: 肾上腺耗竭会导致你情绪骤降，并因此感到非常难过。

sentences.en: So I've, I've struggled with that before.
sentences.zh: 所以我以前确实与此作过斗争。

sentences.en: I think more of what I brought into the headspace is the feeling of just never feeling like you're doing it right.
sentences.zh: 我想我带入这种精神状态的更多是那种感觉，永远觉得自己做得不对。

sentences.en: Like, I, I just, I, I just kind of like live in guilt and just, you know, is this the right breakfast?
sentences.zh: 就像，我——我——我差不多就是活在内疚中，你知道的，这早餐对吗？

sentences.en: Is this what we should be talking about on the way home from school?
sentences.zh: 这是我们从学校回家的路上应该聊的话题吗？

sentences.en: I just, I just, I just kind of am always worried that I'm failing them and I can keep myself from being like swallowed by that.
sentences.zh: 我只是——我只是——我只是总是担心自己让他们失望了，而我能阻止自己被这种情绪吞没。

sentences.en: Cause I, I know I'm a good mom and I know my kids are happy and I have a great husband and I have like great support at home.
sentences.zh: 因为我——我知道我是一个好妈妈，我知道我的孩子们很开心，我有一个极好的丈夫，我在家里有很好的支持。

sentences.en: So I can like do a reality check and be like, everybody's okay.
sentences.zh: 所以我可以进行现实检验，心想，大家都很好。

sentences.en: You're just spinning, but she can't and she doesn't.
sentences.zh: 你只是在胡思乱想，但她做不到，她不会这样想。

sentences.en: And so she really just goes there.
sentences.zh: 所以她真的就那样深陷其中了。

sentences.en: So that was very easy for me to follow that.
sentences.zh: 因此，顺着那个思绪螺旋走下去对我来说非常容易。

sentences.en: That spiral.
sentences.zh: 那个深渊。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Spin down the drain.
sentences.zh: 付诸东流。

sentences.en: The other thing that she sort of deals with is a loss of her creative self that is also really hard.
sentences.zh: 她遇到的另一件事是失去了那种充满创造力的自我，这也是非常难熬的。

sentences.en: I mean, one of the things that I think as, as mothers, you can feel often is just how your child seems to just leech all of the, all of the energy,
sentences.zh: 我是说，作为母亲，你常常会有一种感觉，觉得你的孩子好像抽干了你身上所有的、所有的精力，

sentences.en: all of the feeling of motivation out of you and you just give it all to them.
sentences.zh: 抽干了你所有的积极性，而你把这一切都毫无保留地给了他们。

sentences.en: And as someone who is in a creative field as an actor, I mean, was that something that you kind of were able to connect with?
sentences.zh: 作为一个从事创意领域的演员，我是说，你觉得自己能对这种感受有所共鸣吗？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: I mean, having kids is sacrificial and it's gratifying and it's amazing and rewarding.
sentences.zh: 我是说，养育孩子是有牺牲的，但它也是令人欣慰的、美妙的且有回报的。

sentences.en: It's all of the things, but it's not, not sacrificial.
sentences.zh: 它包含了一切，但它确实是存在牺牲的。

sentences.en: And yeah, I've never had to say no to something before that I really wanted to do.
sentences.zh: 而且，以前我从不需要对真正想做的事情说不。

sentences.en: I could just go do it.
sentences.zh: 我只要去做了就行。

sentences.en: I do wrestle with, it feels vain and selfish that I love being a creative person as much as I do.
sentences.zh: 我的确会陷入这种纠结：我会觉得自己作为一个热爱创作的人，竟然这么热爱它，这显得很虚荣也很自私。

sentences.en: My kids and my family are more important, obviously, but they feel like equal parts of me, like an equal part.
sentences.zh: 显然，我的孩子们和我的家庭更重要，但它们对我来说同样重要，就像是我不可分割的一部分。

sentences.en: Like I would not be complete if I couldn't make movies.
sentences.zh: 就好像如果我不能拍电影，我就不再完整了。

sentences.en: I just wouldn't.
sentences.zh: 真的会这样。

sentences.en: And on the one hand, like when I had my son, my firstborn, I was like, being an actress is the perfect job for being a hands-on mom.
sentences.zh: 一方面，当我生下儿子、也就是我的长子时，我心想，当演员简直是当一个亲力亲为的妈妈的完美工作。

sentences.en: Like I, I can go years without working.
sentences.zh: 我可以好几年不工作。

sentences.en: I can be so hands-on, you know, and then I go work a little bit.
sentences.zh: 我可以全心全意地陪伴孩子，你知道的，然后偶尔去工作一小段时间。

sentences.en: They visit, yada, yada, yada.
sentences.zh: 他们来探班，诸如此类的。

sentences.en: And like, this is perfect.
sentences.zh: 然后我就觉得，这太完美了。

sentences.en: And then now I'm realizing, I'm like, oh, that was COVID and you are quite busy.
sentences.zh: 可现在我才意识到，哦，那是因为当时正好碰上疫情，而你现在其实挺忙的。

sentences.en: And so I'm kind of reckoning with that and have been of just like, how much is it okay to love this and not want to give it up?
sentences.zh: 所以我一直在接受这个现实，并且一直在琢磨：究竟有多么热爱这一切、并且不想放弃它是可以被允许的？

sentences.en: I definitely relate to that.
sentences.zh: 我对此真的深有同感。

sentences.en: I, I found the opposite problem with creativity.
sentences.zh: 我发现自己在创造力方面遇到了完全相反的问题。

sentences.en: I, I had so much anxiety when my second was born that the only way I could escape was in stories and books and in particular, the American Revolution.
sentences.zh: 我生第二个孩子的时候感到了巨大的焦虑，我唯一的逃避方式就是沉浸在故事和书里，尤其是关于美国独立战争的故事。

sentences.en: And so I really lost myself and kind of ideas.
sentences.zh: 所以我真的在各种观点中迷失了自我。

sentences.en: And that's always been how I digest feelings.
sentences.zh: 而这一直都是我消化情绪的方式。

sentences.en: The American Revolution, do tell.
sentences.zh: 美国独立战争，快跟我讲讲。

sentences.en: Well, I read this amazing book called The Revolutionary by Stacey Schiff.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我读了一本非常棒的书，叫斯泰西·希夫写的《革命者》。

sentences.en: I haven't read it.
sentences.zh: 我没读过。

sentences.en: It's about like Sam Adams and just kind of, I feel like the closest thing we can get to a crystal ball is history.
sentences.zh: 这本书讲的是萨姆·亚当斯之类的人，我觉得历史就像是我们能找到的最接近水晶球的东西。

sentences.en: And I feel like we're all kind of fighting over what it means to be an American right now.
sentences.zh: 而且我觉得我们现在都在为“身为美国人意味着什么”而争论不休。

sentences.en: And so I just was interested in what the original Americans' ideals were.
sentences.zh: 所以我只是对最初的美国人拥有怎样的理想很感兴趣。

sentences.en: What did they think that they were building?
sentences.zh: 他们当时觉得自己正在构建什么？

sentences.en: What did they think they were getting away from?
sentences.zh: 他们觉得自己正在摆脱什么？

sentences.en: And what did they think they were creating?
sentences.zh: 他们又觉得自己正在创造什么？

sentences.en: I do want to talk about the American Revolution and politics, but I wanted to ask you one more thing about the film that struck me.
sentences.zh: 我确实很想聊聊美国独立战争和政治，但关于这部电影，我还想问你一件事，它让我印象深刻。

sentences.en: There's a lot of nudity in the film.
sentences.zh: 电影里有很多裸露镜头。

sentences.en: There's a lot of unvarnished nudity in the film.
sentences.zh: 电影里有很多赤裸坦诚的裸露镜头。

sentences.en: And, you know, knowing that you were pregnant, I'm just wondering how you, we have such a complicated relationship in this country with nudity and women.
sentences.zh: 而且，考虑到你当时怀孕了，我很好奇你是怎么看待……在这个国家，我们对裸露和女性有着如此复杂的态度。

sentences.en: And, and I was wondering how you thought about that in the film and like challenges of that.
sentences.zh: 我想知道你在电影中是如何看待这一点的，以及其中面临的挑战。

sentences.en: Um, I'm definitely not bothered by people that are bothered by nudity.
sentences.zh: 嗯，对于那些对裸露感到介意的人，我其实一点也不在意他们的看法。

sentences.en: They don't have to see it.
sentences.zh: 他们可以不看。

sentences.en: They can fast forward it.
sentences.zh: 他们可以快进。

sentences.en: Um, but I don't, I don't really care about being judged in that way.
sentences.zh: 嗯，但我真的不在乎以那种方式遭到评判。

sentences.en: There's this freedom of vanity in a way because I'm pregnant and it's my second.
sentences.zh: 某种程度上，这反而有一种摆脱了虚荣的自由，因为我怀孕了，而且这是我的第二胎。

sentences.en: Like I've really was not adequately prepared for how I was like, oh, I'll just be like four or five months.
sentences.zh: 我真的完全没有做好心理准备，我当时想，哦，我大概只会显怀四五个月吧。

sentences.en: Like I won't even start showing until I'm like six or seven months.
sentences.zh: 就像我大概六七个月的时候才会开始显怀。

sentences.en: And that's not true when it's your second.
sentences.zh: 但怀第二胎的时候可就不是这样了。

sentences.en: Um, I just kind of had to like let go of any vanity.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我只能选择放下任何虚荣心。

sentences.en: I mean, I sucked in as hard as I possibly could have, but I wasn't going to diet.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我已经把肚子吸得不能再紧了，但我可不打算节食。

sentences.en: I was pregnant.
sentences.zh: 我怀孕了。

sentences.en: I couldn't exercise.
sentences.zh: 我没法运动。

sentences.en: I was working.
sentences.zh: 我还要工作。

sentences.en: So there's just like this kind of like real freedom to it.
sentences.zh: 所以这里面其实有一种真正的自由感。

sentences.en: Um, did that feel good?
sentences.zh: 嗯，那种感觉好吗？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: That release?
sentences.zh: 那种释放感？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: It feels nice.
sentences.zh: 感觉很好。

sentences.en: I mean, I do have moments where I'm like, what technically are the differences between me and a prostitute?
sentences.zh: 我是说，我确实也有过这样的时刻：从技术层面上讲，我和一个性工作者到底有什么区别？

sentences.en: But it doesn't keep me up at night.
sentences.zh: 但这并没有让我夜不能寐。

sentences.en: What?
sentences.zh: 什么？

sentences.en: Well, I don't think that there's anything wrong with prostitution either.
sentences.zh: 呃，其实我也不觉得性工作有什么不对的。

sentences.en: I don't, I, I, I'm not saying that there is.
sentences.zh: 我没有，我、我、我不是那个意思。

sentences.en: I just, it's, it's funny that your mind went there.
sentences.zh: 我只是觉得，你的脑回路居然能拐到那里去，挺逗的。

sentences.en: Oh, I'm very good at attacking myself.
sentences.zh: 哦，我可太擅长自我批判了。

sentences.en: I can find every angle.
sentences.zh: 我能找出所有的刁钻角度。

sentences.en: In fact, I should do this interview.
sentences.zh: 事实上，这场采访应该由我来做。

sentences.en: What would you ask you?
sentences.zh: 你会问自己什么问题？

sentences.en: No, my God, it would be so sad.
sentences.zh: 不，天哪，那可就太惨了。

sentences.en: Um.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: Sorry, I have to pause each other.
sentences.zh: 抱歉，我们得暂停一下。

sentences.en: Oh, no, it means she didn't like something.
sentences.zh: 哦不，这意味着她不喜欢某个东西。

sentences.en: What'd I say?
sentences.zh: 我刚才说什么了？

sentences.en: Actually, now that we're paused, I'm going to pee.
sentences.zh: 其实，趁现在暂停，我要去上个厕所。

sentences.en: Okay, at this point, Jennifer Lawrence gets up.
sentences.zh: 好的，就在这时，詹妮弗·劳伦斯站了起来。

sentences.en: We take a little break.
sentences.zh: 我们休息了一小会儿。

sentences.en: Then a few minutes later, she comes and sits back down for the rest of the interview.
sentences.zh: 然后几分钟后，她回来坐下，继续完成剩下的采访。

sentences.en: Is everything okay?
sentences.zh: 一切都好吗？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 挺好的。

sentences.en: No, I didn't get yelled at.
sentences.zh: 没有啦，我没挨骂。

sentences.en: I just peed.
sentences.zh: 我只是去上厕所了。

sentences.en: I believe in freedom of the press.
sentences.zh: 我坚信新闻自由。

sentences.en: I believe in freedom of the press, too.
sentences.zh: 我也坚信新闻自由。

sentences.en: Damn it.
sentences.zh: 该死。

sentences.en: That reminds me of one battle after another.
sentences.zh: 这让我想起了一场接一场的战斗。

sentences.en: Talking about freedom, baby.
sentences.zh: 咱们聊的是自由，宝贝。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So, the other thing is that you, your sort of persona in the world, has been someone who is very funny and out there and has sometimes been viewed as, like, too loud, too much,
sentences.zh: 所以，另一件事是，你在公众面前的人设一直是一个非常有趣、外向、有时甚至被视为过于喧闹、过于夸张的人，

sentences.en: and has sort of faced backlash.
sentences.zh: 并且因此遭遇了一些猛烈的回击。

sentences.en: And also, people are charmed by it.
sentences.zh: 但与此同时，人们又对这种特质着迷。

sentences.en: And I was wondering, now looking back at that era,
sentences.zh: 我想知道，现在回看那个时期，

sentences.en: what do you think about how you were perceived and how you sort of interacted with the public as you were coming up when you were younger?
sentences.zh: 当你年轻刚出道时，对于自己当时是如何被大众感知以及如何与公众互动的，你现在有什么看法？

sentences.en: I mean, now that I'm in my 30s and a mom, I can see how young I was.
sentences.zh: 我是说，现在我三十多岁了，也是个母亲，我能看出我当时有多年轻。

sentences.en: Like, when I meet a 23-year-old now, I mean, think about a 23-year-old.
sentences.zh: 比如，现在我遇到一个23岁的年轻人时，你想想23岁的人。

sentences.en: They're children.
sentences.zh: 他们还是孩子呢。

sentences.en: And so, as horrified as I am at some things, like, if something comes across my phone, I just, like, absolutely could never watch it.
sentences.zh: 所以，每当我看到一些东西时都会感到震惊，比如如果有什么内容弹到我的手机上，我绝对、绝对根本没法看下去。

sentences.en: Like, an old interview or something, I'm just like, oh, my God, like, so cringe.
sentences.zh: 比如一段当年的老采访什么的，我只会觉得，天哪，太让人脚趾抠地了。

sentences.en: But I get it.
sentences.zh: 但我能理解。

sentences.en: I was young and nervous and defensive and, like, awkward.
sentences.zh: 我当时很年轻、很紧张、充满防备，而且有点笨拙。

sentences.en: I remember when I was nominated for Silver Linings and somebody was like, everybody loves you.
sentences.zh: 我记得当我因为《乌云背后的幸福线》获得提名时，有人问我：“所有人现在都爱你，”,

sentences.en: What does that feel like?
sentences.zh: “那种感觉是什么样的？”

sentences.en: And I was like, it feels, like, precarious, you know, like I'm waiting for it because, like, it's not, you know, it's going to come down.
sentences.zh: 当时我说：“感觉很不踏实，你知道的，就像我在等待靴子落地一样，因为这不会长久，你知道的，热度总会降下来的。”

sentences.en: That's just, like, the nature of things.
sentences.zh: 这就是事物的规律。

sentences.en: And then I fell getting my Oscar and then the next year, I remember the moment I was waving to fans and I tripped on a cone and I remember being like, fuck, that's it.
sentences.zh: 然后我在领奥斯卡奖时摔倒了，接着第二年，我记得有一次我正向粉丝挥手，结果被一个路障圆锥绊倒了，我当时心想：操，完了。

sentences.en: Like, nobody's going to believe that.
sentences.zh: “这下没人会信了。”

sentences.en: Nobody's going to believe that I fell two years in a row.
sentences.zh: “没人会相信我连续两年都摔倒了。”

sentences.en: I did.
sentences.zh: 但我确实摔了。

sentences.en: Because after you tripped on your Oscar, people said that I faked it.
sentences.zh: 因为在你领奥斯卡摔倒之后，人们说我是假摔。

sentences.en: That you faked it.
sentences.zh: 说你是装的。

sentences.en: Yeah, I didn't.
sentences.zh: 对，我才没有装。

sentences.en: And so that became, I was just like, yeah, I'm fucked.
sentences.zh: 所以情况就变成了，我当时想：好吧，我完蛋了。

sentences.en: And I was.
sentences.zh: 我的确完了。

sentences.en: Everybody just kind of thought that meant everything that I did was fake and it was, like, all a shtick.
sentences.zh: 每个人都觉得这意味着我做的一切都是假的，全都是在演戏、装疯卖傻。

sentences.en: This is how it felt to me that I just kind of got, like, found out as this, like, fraud.
sentences.zh: 我当时的真实感受就是，我这个骗子的身份终于被大家当场拆穿了。

sentences.en: I mean, you said at that moment that you felt that other people had gotten sick of you and you had gotten sick of yourself.
sentences.zh: 我是说，你当时曾说过，你觉得别人已经对你感到厌烦了，你自己也对你自己感到厌烦。

sentences.en: And I'm interested in that you had gotten sick of yourself.
sentences.zh: 我对“你也对你自己感到厌烦”这一点很感兴趣。

sentences.en: What did that mean?
sentences.zh: 那是什么意思？

sentences.en: I was sick of doing this and doing interviews is really scary.
sentences.zh: 我厌倦了这样做，而且做采访真的太吓人了。

sentences.en: Like, I'm very blessed.
sentences.zh: 就像，我真的很有福气。

sentences.en: I'm very lucky.
sentences.zh: 我非常幸运。

sentences.en: I'm very grateful.
sentences.zh: 我非常感激。

sentences.en: I have a great job.
sentences.zh: 我有一份很棒的工作。

sentences.en: But it's terrifying.
sentences.zh: 但这也太可怕了。

sentences.en: Like, you finish an interview and, or, you know, you're gearing up to release a film and it's like, you know, the circus tent, the curtains are opening.
sentences.zh: 就像你完成了一场采访，或者，你知道的，你正准备宣传一部电影，这就好比，马戏团的帐篷、帷幕要拉开了。

sentences.en: And it's just like, you're putting yourself out there and you're putting yourself out there to be picked apart and it's scary.
sentences.zh: 这就好像你在把自己赤裸裸地展现在公众面前，任由别人评头论足，这很吓人。

sentences.en: And I was just so tired of it.
sentences.zh: 我当时真的是太累了。

sentences.en: I was just so tired of being quoted and people talking about the quotes.
sentences.zh: 我太厌倦看到自己的话被到处引用，也厌倦了人们讨论那些引言。

sentences.en: You know, I just was so tired of seeing myself in that, in that way.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我太厌倦以那种方式看到自己了。

sentences.en: Um, I needed a break from it.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我当时真的很需要从这种状态中抽离出来休息一下。

sentences.en: People needed a break from it.
sentences.zh: 大家也都需要从我身上歇口气。

sentences.en: Then I took a break and enjoyed the break.
sentences.zh: 然后我就休息了，并且很享受这段假期。

sentences.en: Like, it was a mutual break up.
sentences.zh: 就像是一场和平分手。

sentences.en: What did you do during that period where you took a step back?
sentences.zh: 在你退居幕后的那段时间里，你都做了些什么？

sentences.en: Because that was a two and a half year period where you weren't actually out in front.
sentences.zh: 因为那是一段长达两年半、你没有真正出现在聚光灯下的时期。

sentences.en: You got married.
sentences.zh: 你结婚了。

sentences.en: It was COVID.
sentences.zh: 当时又赶上疫情。

sentences.en: So there's reasons for all of that.
sentences.zh: 所以这一切都是有原因的。

sentences.en: But how were you recalibrating during that period?
sentences.zh: 但在那段时期，你是如何调整自己的状态的？

sentences.en: I don't really know.
sentences.zh: 我其实也不知道。

sentences.en: I lived with my cousin for a little bit.
sentences.zh: 我和我表妹一起住了好一会儿。

sentences.en: Hi, cuz.
sentences.zh: 嗨，表妹。

sentences.en: Because we were like in our, I don't know, mid-twenties.
sentences.zh: 因为我们当时大概二十五六岁的样子。

sentences.en: She just kind of moved into my apartment in New York and we became roommates.
sentences.zh: 她直接搬进了我在纽约的公寓，然后我们就成了室友。

sentences.en: And it was fun.
sentences.zh: 那段日子挺开心的。

sentences.en: We watched TV.
sentences.zh: 我们一起看电视。

sentences.en: I took my dog to Central Park.
sentences.zh: 我带着我的狗去中央公园散步。

sentences.en: Then I fell in love.
sentences.zh: 然后我坠入爱河了。

sentences.en: Then I started learning more about contemporary post-war art.
sentences.zh: 接着我开始更多地了解战后当代艺术。

sentences.en: As you do.
sentences.zh: 可不是嘛。

sentences.en: As you do.
sentences.zh: 可不是嘛。

sentences.en: Oh, my husband's an art dealer.
sentences.zh: 哦，我丈夫是个艺术品经纪人。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 这样啊。

sentences.en: May I ask how you met your husband?
sentences.zh: 请问你是怎么认识你丈夫的？

sentences.en: Yeah, he showed me art.
sentences.zh: 对，他带我看了艺术品。

sentences.en: I was considering buying something and I asked my friend Gene, who actually ended up directing me in No Hard Feelings, but I asked him, do you know anybody in the art world?
sentences.zh: 我当时正考虑买点东西，于是我问了我的朋友吉恩——他后来其实还执导了我的《调教处男》——我问他，你在艺术圈里有人脉吗？

sentences.en: And he sent me Cook's number and I didn't know, you know, and then I showed up to the gallery and was like, oh, my God, what is your deal?
sentences.zh: 然后他把库克的电话号码发给了我，我当时也不懂，你知道的，接着我就去了画廊，心想：天哪，你这是什么情况？

sentences.en: And then he stopped being my art advisor.
sentences.zh: 然后他就不再当我的艺术顾问了。

sentences.en: Do you find it hard to be your authentic self when you're trying to interact with the public because of what you went through?
sentences.zh: 因为你曾经经历过的事，当你想跟公众互动时，你觉得要做回真实的自己很难吗？

sentences.en: Because I saw you at this press conference that you gave in Spain and you seem a lot more reserved than you used to be, more careful, more considered.
sentences.zh: 因为我看到你在西班牙开的那场记者会上，你看起来比以前内敛多了，更谨慎，也更深思熟虑。

sentences.en: And I'm just wondering if that is deliberate.
sentences.zh: 我想知道这是否是刻意为之。

sentences.en: Yeah, I mean, I think I've also grown up and I'm a lot more nervous about whatever I say publicly.
sentences.zh: 对，我的意思是，我觉得我也长大了，而且对于自己在公开场合说的话，我也变得更加紧张了。

sentences.en: I try not to, you know, I don't want to like give an interview that's like a bunch of like sound bites and like a word salad.
sentences.zh: 我尽量不去——你知道的，我不想搞出一堆诸如吸睛金句和词汇沙拉一样的采访。

sentences.en: I just like I don't think that that's like interesting and I don't feel like that's like what I'm like.
sentences.zh: 我只是觉得那一点意思也没有，而且我觉得那根本不是真正的我。

sentences.en: Like it just would feel so inauthentic and not like what I'm here to do.
sentences.zh: 那种感觉会太不真实，也根本不是我来这里的目的。

sentences.en: So I'm trying to strike that balance.
sentences.zh: 所以我正在努力把握好这个平衡。

sentences.en: I mean, I'm going to break the fourth wall here, but I mean, it's always a strange thing to do, right?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我要打破第四堵墙了，但我觉得，做这种事总是很奇怪，对吧？

sentences.en: I'm a journalist asking you questions.
sentences.zh: 我是个记者，在向你提问。

sentences.en: I obviously want you to give revealing answers and you have to protect yourself as an artist and as a private person in the world.
sentences.zh: 我显然希望你能给出掏心掏肺的回答，而作为一名艺术家和一个生活在世俗中的私人，你又必须保护好自己。

sentences.en: And so I often think about how complicated that dance is, especially for women.
sentences.zh: 所以我经常思考这种拉扯有多复杂，尤其是对女性而言。

sentences.en: I mean, do you think as a female artist that you have been treated differently than perhaps other, you know, men?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，你认为作为一名女性艺术家，你受到的对待是否与其他人——比如，你知道的，男性——有所不同？

sentences.en: Because you were young, you were open to the world in a way that perhaps other people aren't.
sentences.zh: 因为你年轻过，你对世界敞开胸怀的方式或许是其他人所没有的。

sentences.en: You didn't seem so jaded, I think.
sentences.zh: 我觉得你当时看起来并没有那么饱经沧桑。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你。

sentences.en: I don't know if it's different than if I were a man because I've just never lived that existence.
sentences.zh: 我不知道这跟我是不是个男的有没有区别，因为我从来没有过那种生活。

sentences.en: I only know this one.
sentences.zh: 我只经历过这种生活。

sentences.en: That was the wrong question.
sentences.zh: 我刚才那个问题问得不对。

sentences.en: And I feel, no, no, no, it wasn't.
sentences.zh: 我觉得，不，不，不，其实也不是。

sentences.en: I'm getting around to it.
sentences.zh: 我正要切入正题呢。

sentences.en: I'm just dancing around your question because we are doing the dance.
sentences.zh: 我只是在你的问题周围绕圈子，因为我们在跳这支舞。

sentences.en: We are.
sentences.zh: 我们确实在跳。

sentences.en: I feel it when it's time for women to be the morality police.
sentences.zh: 每当轮到女性去充当道德警察的时候，我总能感觉得到。

sentences.en: You know, it's easy for me to see it when it's happening.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，当这种事发生时，我很容易就能看出来。

sentences.en: You know, when somebody does a Woody Allen movie and they only ask the women, you know, well, how do you feel about working with Woody Allen?
sentences.zh: 你知道的，当有人演了伍迪·艾伦的电影，而记者却只去质问女性——你知道的，“嗯，你对跟伍迪·艾伦合作有什么看法？”

sentences.en: You know, and you can just watch it.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，你只要看着就行了。

sentences.en: You can just watch not one male actor get asked that question.
sentences.zh: 你会发现压根没有一个男演员会被问到这个问题。

sentences.en: And I see that play out a lot of just like women being the examples, women being the morality police.
sentences.zh: 我经常看到这种现象上演，女性成了反面教材，女性成了道德警察。

sentences.en: And also I think there is something, I don't know what it is.
sentences.zh: 而且我也觉得有些事，我不知道那是什么。

sentences.en: It's really easy to hate women viciously in a way that it's almost like we have this ire in us that specifically there's like an extra pocket for it.
sentences.zh: 狠狠地去痛恨女性实在是太容易了，那种感觉就好像我们内心有一股怒火，专门为她们准备了一个额外的发泄口袋。

sentences.en: And the ire that people are capable of, I think, is different.
sentences.zh: 我觉得人们能爆发出的那种怒火是不一样的。

sentences.en: I never at any point felt like this is unfair because of my gender.
sentences.zh: 我从来没有在任何时刻觉得这不公平是因为我的性别。

sentences.en: I felt like this is unfair because you created this.
sentences.zh: 我只觉得这不公平是因为这一切都是你们造成的。

sentences.en: You ask and you ask and you ask and you want and you want and you want and then you don't want it anymore.
sentences.zh: 你们索取、索取、索取，你们渴望、渴望、渴望，然后你们又不想要了。

sentences.en: And I felt like rejected.
sentences.zh: 我当时感觉自己被抛弃了。

sentences.en: But that's, now that I'm older, that is a natural push-pull of the process.
sentences.zh: 但现在，随着我年纪渐长，我明白了这是这个过程里自然的拉锯战。

sentences.en: And I have to be in control of how much access is given and how much isn't.
sentences.zh: 我必须掌控好向外界敞开多少，以及保留多少。

sentences.en: After the break, Jennifer tells me about being politically outspoken early in her career and why she's approaching things differently now.
sentences.zh: 广告之后，詹妮弗将跟我聊聊她职业生涯早期在政治上直言不讳的经历，以及为什么她现在采取了不同的处理方式。

sentences.en: Celebrities do not make a difference whatsoever on who people vote for.
sentences.zh: 名人们对人们把票投给谁根本产生不了任何影响。

sentences.en: And so then what am I doing?
sentences.zh: 那我还在这儿干嘛呢？

sentences.en: I'm Winnalou.
sentences.zh: 我是温娜露。

sentences.en: I write the game Connections, one of the puzzles from New York Times games.
sentences.zh: 我编写“连连看（Connections）”游戏，这是《纽约时报》益智游戏中的一款。

sentences.en: And I love horror movies.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢恐怖电影。

sentences.en: I love my dog.
sentences.zh: 我爱我的狗。

sentences.en: And I love trying to trick you.
sentences.zh: 我还喜欢试着捉弄你们。

sentences.en: I'm Sam Mazursky.
sentences.zh: 我是萨姆·马祖斯基。

sentences.en: And I create the game Spelling Bee and Letterboxd on a daily basis.
sentences.zh: 我每天负责创作“拼字蜜蜂（Spelling Bee）”和“字母箱（Letterboxd）”游戏。

sentences.en: And I have this thing called promesthesia.
sentences.zh: 我有一种叫做“彩色联觉”的奇妙特质。

sentences.en: I see color when I'm listening to music.
sentences.zh: 我听音乐时能看到颜色。

sentences.en: New York Times games are made by people, like the ones you just heard from.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的益智游戏是由一个个活生生的人制作的，就像你刚才听到声音的这些人一样。

sentences.en: Go to nytimes.com slash games to start playing today.
sentences.zh: 访问 nytimes.com/games，今天就开始游玩吧。

sentences.en: I did want to ask you about your relationship with some of your directors.
sentences.zh: 我确实想问问你和几位导演的关系。

sentences.en: Because you have been with directors who are known as being very difficult, challenging directors.
sentences.zh: 因为你合作过的导演都是那种以非常难搞、极具挑战性而著称的导演。

sentences.en: People who are auteurs, have really clear visions.
sentences.zh: 那些具有作者风格、有着极其清晰愿景的人。

sentences.en: And, you know, for example, when you were making Mother with Darren Aronofsky, you hyperventilated, you tore your diaphragm, you got medical attention.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道的，举个例子，当你和达伦·阿罗诺夫斯基合作拍摄《母亲！》时，你曾过度换气，撕裂了横膈膜，还接受了医疗救治。

sentences.en: And then he made you film the scene again when you got back.
sentences.zh: 然后等你回来后，他又让你把那个镜头重新拍了一遍。

sentences.en: And I'm just wondering what that kind of intensity does for you.
sentences.zh: 我想知道那种高强度对你来说意味着什么？

sentences.en: Like, how do you work with directors who really bring that out in you and demand that of you?
sentences.zh: 比如，你是如何与那些真能把你的潜能逼出来、对你提出这种要求的导演合作的？

sentences.en: I stay loose.
sentences.zh: 我保持放松。

sentences.en: I think David O.
sentences.zh: 我觉得大卫·O·拉塞尔

sentences.en: Russell really taught me how to— I think because of David, I've never really, it's never really mattered what the director's kind of methodology is.
sentences.zh: 真的教会了我如何——我想正是因为大卫，我才真正觉得，导演采用什么样的方法论其实根本不重要。

sentences.en: I can kind of—
sentences.zh: 我差不多能——

sentences.en: I mean, Amy Adams, who was in American Hustle with you, and that was obviously David O.
sentences.zh: 我是说，曾和你一起出演《美国骗局》的艾米·亚当斯——那部戏显然也是大卫·O·拉塞尔导演的——她曾这样评价你：

sentences.en: Russell, said of you,
sentences.zh: 艾米·亚当斯说：

sentences.en: Jennifer doesn't take any of it on.
sentences.zh: 詹妮弗什么都不往心里去。

sentences.en: She's Teflon.
sentences.zh: 她简直是特氟龙。

sentences.en: And sort of saying that you don't absorb some of that stuff.
sentences.zh: 意思就是你不会去吸收那些负面的东西。

sentences.en: Yeah, I didn't.
sentences.zh: 对，我确实没有。

sentences.en: But I really felt like David, that was his way of communicating in a non-bullshit way.
sentences.zh: 但我真的觉得大卫那种方式是在以一种毫无废话的方式进行沟通。

sentences.en: I never felt like he was, like, degrading or yelling at me.
sentences.zh: 我从来不觉得他是在贬低我或是对我有吼有叫。

sentences.en: Like, if he didn't like something, he was just like, that was terrible.
sentences.zh: 比如，如果他不喜欢某个地方，他就会直接说：这太烂了。

sentences.en: It looked like shit.
sentences.zh: 看起来像狗屎一样。

sentences.en: Do it better.
sentences.zh: 给我演得更好点。

sentences.en: And that was, like, a very helpful conversation.
sentences.zh: 而那其实是一次非常管用的对话。

sentences.en: Like, oh, okay.
sentences.zh: 就好像，哦，好的。

sentences.en: I'll do it better.
sentences.zh: 我会演得更好的。

sentences.en: How so?
sentences.zh: 怎么个好法？

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: Slower?
sentences.zh: 放慢点？

sentences.en: Not so loud?
sentences.zh: 声音别那么大？

sentences.en: It was just very, you know—and I'm not sensitive.
sentences.zh: 这其实非常，你知道的——而且我这人并不敏感。

sentences.en: I don't know how you can be in this industry.
sentences.zh: 我不知道你怎么能在这个行业里混下去。

sentences.en: Like, especially, I mean, these young girls hopefully are going to grow up in a different time.
sentences.zh: 尤其是，我的意思是，这些年轻女孩希望能在不同的时代长大成人。

sentences.en: Well, I mean, Amy Adams said that she cried on set.
sentences.zh: 好吧，我的意思是，艾米·亚当斯说过她在片场哭过。

sentences.en: When she talked about you being Teflon, she said that for her, it was hard.
sentences.zh: 当她夸你是特氟龙体质时，她说这对他而言很难。

sentences.en: Well, he might—maybe he was harder on her than he was on me.
sentences.zh: 好吧，他可能——也许他对她比对我更严厉吧。

sentences.en: And also, I don't know.
sentences.zh: 而且，我也不知道。

sentences.en: I mean, yes, of course I'm sensitive.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，对，我当然很敏感。

sentences.en: I'm really sensitive.
sentences.zh: 我其实非常敏感。

sentences.en: I don't even know why I said that.
sentences.zh: 我都不知道自己刚才为什么要那样说。

sentences.en: I was about to say, we've literally had this entire conversation about how sensitive you are.
sentences.zh: 我刚想说，我们刚才明明聊了整整半天，全都是关于你有多敏感。

sentences.en: I'm so sensitive.
sentences.zh: 我超级敏感。

sentences.en: I can't believe I just said that.
sentences.zh: 我简直不敢相信自己刚才说出了那话。

sentences.en: I had a conversation with a girl the other night.
sentences.zh: 前天晚上我和一个女孩聊天。

sentences.en: She was like, oh, I'm the middle of two—with two brothers.
sentences.zh: 她说，哦，我夹在两个——我有两个兄弟。

sentences.en: And I was like, I'm the middle child with two brothers.
sentences.zh: 然后我说，我也是家里中间那个，有两个兄弟。

sentences.en: And we just, like, talked about it passionately for five minutes.
sentences.zh: 然后我们俩就，就像那样充满激情地聊了五分钟。

sentences.en: And then I was like, I'm the youngeSt.
sentences.zh: 接着我说，我是老小。

sentences.en: I'm sorry.
sentences.zh: 不好意思。

sentences.en: And she gave me the weirdest look, obviously.
sentences.zh: 显而易见，她用最古怪的眼神看了我一眼。

sentences.en: Because, what?
sentences.zh: 因为，什么鬼？

sentences.en: But that was that.
sentences.zh: 但事情就是这样。

sentences.en: I'm like, I'm not sensitive.
sentences.zh: 我就像是在说，我不敏感。

sentences.en: I'm extremely sensitive.
sentences.zh: 我极其敏感。

sentences.en: I was going to say, I didn't want to say anything.
sentences.zh: 我本想说，我本来什么都不想说的。

sentences.en: But I was like, we have talked now for quite a bit about this.
sentences.zh: 但我想说，我们刚才已经聊了好一会儿关于这个话题了。

sentences.en: I'm more sensitive than Amy Adams, just flat out.
sentences.zh: 我比艾米·亚当斯更敏感，直截了当地说。

sentences.en: I guess I don't mean anything I say.
sentences.zh: 我猜我刚才说的话没有一句是当真的。

sentences.en: Do you still want to continue interviewing me?
sentences.zh: 你还想继续采访我吗？

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 当然想。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: But maybe you're less sensitive about the acting.
sentences.zh: 但也许你在演戏这件事上没那么敏感。

sentences.en: I guess what I'm trying to get at here—
sentences.zh: 我猜我真正想表达的是——

sentences.en: Yeah, I'm not sensitive about acting.
sentences.zh: 对，我对演戏一点都不敏感。

sentences.en: I'm not competitive about acting.
sentences.zh: 我对演戏没有好胜心。

sentences.en: My husband is always really amazed because I am so competitive.
sentences.zh: 我丈夫总是觉得很震惊，因为我的好胜心其实极强。

sentences.en: Like, when we play tennis, I throw my racket.
sentences.zh: 比如，我们打网球时，我会扔拍子。

sentences.en: I scream.
sentences.zh: 我会尖叫。

sentences.en: I rage.
sentences.zh: 我会发狂。

sentences.en: I, like, I can't do a puzzle.
sentences.zh: 我甚至，比如，我都玩不了拼图。

sentences.en: Like, I'm so competitive.
sentences.zh: 我的好胜心就是这么强。

sentences.en: Like, I make eye contact with him when we're brushing teeth sometimes because I'm like, I did it a little bit longer than you.
sentences.zh: 有时候，我们在刷牙时我都会跟他对视，因为我想：我比你多刷了一小会儿。

sentences.en: Did you notice that?
sentences.zh: 你注意到了吗？

sentences.en: And so he finds it fascinating that I'm not competitive with acting.
sentences.zh: 所以他觉得很神奇，我在演戏这件事上竟然没有好胜心。

sentences.en: But I think it's because I feel secure.
sentences.zh: 但我觉得这是因为我内心感到笃定。

sentences.en: So why would I get competitive?
sentences.zh: 那我为什么还要争强好胜呢？

sentences.en: I feel fine.
sentences.zh: 我感觉状态很好。

sentences.en: And so when it comes to getting the director, I mean, you need to have a visionary.
sentences.zh: 所以说到选择导演，我的意思是，你需要一个有远见的人。

sentences.en: I think it's working with a real artist that I can truSt.
sentences.zh: 我觉得跟一个我能真正信任的真正的艺术家合作才是最重要的。

sentences.en: I mean, you're about to do a film with Martin Scorsese, which is coming up.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，你接下来要和马丁·斯科塞斯合作一部电影，这就要开拍了。

sentences.en: Yeah, I don't know if I trust him.
sentences.zh: 对，我不知道我能不能信任他。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: I mean, why would you?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，你凭什么信任？

sentences.en: He's such a neified—
sentences.zh: 他可是一个如此——

sentences.en: He's going to have to really prove himself to me.
sentences.zh: 他得向我好好证明他自己才行。

sentences.en: Tell me about, in advance of working with a director like Martin Scorsese, you haven't actually been directed by him.
sentences.zh: 跟我聊聊，在跟马丁·斯科塞斯这样的导演合作之前——你实际上还没被他执导过——

sentences.en: I mean, how do you prepare for something like that?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，你怎么为这种合作做准备？

sentences.en: I'll probably do what I always do, which is panic and then try to get in touch with like an acting teacher and then meet the acting teacher and then never see them again.
sentences.zh: 我大概会做我一直以来都会做的事，那就是先恐慌，然后试着联系一个表演老师，接着跟表演老师见面，最后再也不见他们。

sentences.en: That's your process.
sentences.zh: 这就是你的流程。

sentences.en: That is my process.
sentences.zh: 这就是我的流程。

sentences.en: And at this point, it's almost like superstitious if I don't take the one meeting and then not follow up.
sentences.zh: 而且在这个时候，如果我不去开那个会，然后也不跟进，感觉就好像有点迷信。

sentences.en: I'll read.
sentences.zh: 我会读的。

sentences.en: I'll be prepared.
sentences.zh: 我会做准备的。

sentences.en: I'll memorize.
sentences.zh: 我会背下来的。

sentences.en: Leo is, you know—
sentences.zh: 莱奥他是，你知道的——

sentences.en: Leonardo DiCaprio.
sentences.zh: 莱昂纳多·迪卡普里奥。

sentences.en: Leonardo DiCaprio.
sentences.zh: 莱昂纳多·迪卡普里奥。

sentences.en: We work together on Don't Look Up.
sentences.zh: 我们在《不要抬头》里合作过。

sentences.en: And he knows when his character was born and what kind of cologne they wear.
sentences.zh: 他甚至知道他的角色是什么时候出生的，用的是什么古龙水。

sentences.en: And like Leo in One Battle After Another is so serious in his commitment and like it's so—it's so real.
sentences.zh: 而且像莱奥在《血战到底》里的投入是那么严肃，就好像——太真实了。

sentences.en: And that's what makes it hilarious.
sentences.zh: 而这正是它搞笑的地方。

sentences.en: You know, his sides are covered in like a look.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他的台词本上写满了各种造型设计。

sentences.en: He's like Carrie Matherson, you know, in Homeland.
sentences.zh: 他就像《国土安全》里的凯莉·马修森，你知道的。

sentences.en: I don't know what sides means.
sentences.zh: 我不知道sides是什么意思。

sentences.en: You don't know what sides mean?
sentences.zh: 你不知道sides是什么意思？

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 不知道。

sentences.en: Oh, excuse me.
sentences.zh: 哦，不好意思。

sentences.en: Sorry.
sentences.zh: 对不起。

sentences.en: Didn't mean to get all the silver screen on you.
sentences.zh: 我不是故意在你面前假装自己很大牌的。

sentences.en: Well, kid.
sentences.zh: 好吧，孩子。

sentences.en: Sides are—
sentences.zh: Sides就是——

sentences.en: Tell me, tell me.
sentences.zh: 快告诉我，快告诉我。

sentences.en: Sides are just like a few pages, like a scene from the whole script.
sentences.zh: Sides其实就是几页纸，比如整个剧本里的一场戏。

sentences.en: So when I was working with Leo, I was just like, I got to be doing whatever he's doing.
sentences.zh: 所以当我和莱奥合作时，我心里想的就是，他做什么我也得做什么。

sentences.en: Like, this is incredible.
sentences.zh: 真的，这太不可思议了。

sentences.en: But Christian Bale changed me a lot to an American Hustle.
sentences.zh: 但克里斯蒂安·贝尔在《美国骗局》中对我改变很大。

sentences.en: I was 23.
sentences.zh: 我当时23岁。

sentences.en: And I remember like I was always very sensitive about getting embarrassed in front of the crew.
sentences.zh: 我记得我当时对在剧组人员面前出丑非常敏感。

sentences.en: And like I thought acting was like embarrassing.
sentences.zh: 而且我觉得演戏是一件很丢脸的事。

sentences.en: And so I would just kind of try to make a point of like not acting until I just absolutely had too, like at action.
sentences.zh: 所以我总是尽量提醒自己不要提前演，直到绝对必须开始的时候再演，比如听到“实拍”的时候。

sentences.en: But then I would see Christian who didn't like—it's not like he stayed in character like all day or anything, like nothing.
sentences.zh: 但后来我看到克里斯蒂安，他并不像——也不是说他一整天都保持在角色状态里什么的，完全不是。

sentences.en: He just—when the crew started getting ready, you know, like the lights started getting ready
sentences.zh: 他只是——当剧组开始准备时，你知道的，比如灯光开始准备

sentences.en: and the sound and it became clear we were going to start rolling soon, he would kind of slowly start getting ready.
sentences.zh: 音响也准备好了，眼看着马上就要开拍了，他就会慢慢开始进入状态。

sentences.en: And then I was like, that seems like a good idea and I should do that when I'm more mature and can handle people looking at me and being like, psh, she's acting.
sentences.zh: 然后我就觉得，这似乎是个好主意，等我更成熟一点、能够应对别人看着我并说“切，她这在演戏呢”的时候，我也该这么做。

sentences.en: You mentioned one battle after another.
sentences.zh: 你提到了《血战到底》。

sentences.en: Oh my God.
sentences.zh: 天哪。

sentences.en: I saw it last night.
sentences.zh: 我昨晚刚看。

sentences.en: I know that it is now further in the future if you're hearing this.
sentences.zh: 我知道如果你听到这段对话时，时间已经更靠后了。

sentences.en: Yes, it doesn't matter what time stamping it.
sentences.zh: 是的，具体是哪天并不重要。

sentences.en: You saw it last night.
sentences.zh: 你昨晚看了。

sentences.en: I saw it last night in 70mm IMAX, as God intended.
sentences.zh: 我昨晚在70毫米IMAX厅看的，正如上帝所愿。

sentences.en: It's the most incredible movie I've ever seen in my entire life.
sentences.zh: 这是我这辈子看过的最不可思议的电影。

sentences.en: I feel so grateful just for that to exiSt.
sentences.zh: 我仅仅为这部电影的存在就感到无比感激。

sentences.en: I just like kiss the ground that that movie walks on.
sentences.zh: 我简直想顶礼膜拜这部电影走过的每一寸土地。

sentences.en: It's also a film that it speaks to, as we started discussing, it speaks to this political moment in a very interesting and important way that is funny, that is complicated.
sentences.zh: 这也是一部能够——正如我们刚才开始讨论的那样，它以一种非常有趣、复杂的方式呼应了当前的政治时刻。

sentences.en: And it's a good idea.
sentences.zh: 而且这是一个好主意。

sentences.en: It's not a bad idea.
sentences.zh: 这不是个坏主意。

sentences.en: What do you mean?
sentences.zh: 你什么意思？

sentences.en: A revolution.
sentences.zh: 一场革命。

sentences.en: You have been politically outspoken in the paSt.
sentences.zh: 你过去在政治上一直直言不讳。

sentences.en: In the first Trump administration, you know, you had a lot to say.
sentences.zh: 在第一届特朗普政府时期，你知道的，你有很多话要说。

sentences.en: I'm curious how you feel about talking out now.
sentences.zh: 我很想知道你现在怎么看待公开直言。

sentences.en: I don't really know if I should.
sentences.zh: 我其实不知道自己是否应该这样做。

sentences.en: I think, like, the first Trump administration was so wild.
sentences.zh: 我觉得，第一届特朗普政府时期实在是太疯狂了。

sentences.en: And just how can we let this stand?
sentences.zh: 而且怎么能就这么无动于衷呢？

sentences.en: Like, I felt like I was running around like a chicken with my head cut off.
sentences.zh: 当时我觉得自己就像一只无头苍蝇一样到处乱撞。

sentences.en: But as we've learned, election after election, celebrities do not make a difference whatsoever on who people vote for.
sentences.zh: 但正如我们一次次选举所学到的那样，名人对人们究竟把票投给谁根本没有任何影响。

sentences.en: And so then what am I doing?
sentences.zh: 那我现在在做什么呢？

sentences.en: I'm just sharing my opinion on something that's going to just add fuel to a fire that's ripping the country apart.
sentences.zh: 我只是在表达自己的观点，这只会给正在撕裂这个国家的大火火上浇油。

sentences.en: I mean, we are so divided.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我们分歧太严重了。

sentences.en: I think I'm in a complicated recalibration because I'm also an artiSt.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我正处于一个复杂的重新调整期，因为我同时也是一名艺术家。

sentences.en: And with this temperature and the way that things can turn out,
sentences.zh: 在目前这种社会温度以及各种事情可能发展到的方向下，

sentences.en: I don't want to start turning people off to films and to art that could change consciousness or change the world because they don't like my political opinions.
sentences.zh: 我不想因为别人不喜欢我的政治观点，就开始让他们对那些能够改变意识或改变世界的电影和艺术产生反感。

sentences.en: I want to protect my craft so that you can still get lost in what I'm doing, what I'm showing.
sentences.zh: 我想保护我的手艺，这样你们才能继续沉浸在我所做的事、我所呈现的东西中。

sentences.en: And if I can't say something that's going to speak to some kind of peace or lowering the temperature or some sort of solution, I just don't want to be a part of the problem.
sentences.zh: 如果我说不出一些能够呼吁某种和平、降低对立情绪或带来某种解决办法的话，我只是不想成为问题的一部分。

sentences.en: I don't want to make the problem worse.
sentences.zh: 我不想让情况变得更糟。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: I mean,
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，

sentences.en: I saw you at a press conference recently when you were speaking about Gaza point to our elected officials as the people who need to be responsible for answering those questions and not putting that on actors and other celebrities to sort of take a stand.
sentences.zh: 我最近在一次新闻发布会上看到你谈到加沙时，指出我们的民选官员才是需要对回答这些问题负责的人，而不应该把这种压力推给演员和其他名人让他们去表明立场。

sentences.en: Yeah, just like if it's like looking at a chess board, you know,
sentences.zh: 对，就像如果你把它看作是一盘棋，你知道的，

sentences.en: you just watch these actors' faces who have had incredible careers and done amazing things and made incredible contributions that all of a sudden one half of the internet or one half of the country just can't stand anymore.
sentences.zh: 你就会看着这些演员的脸，他们曾有过辉煌的职业生涯、做过惊人的成就、做出过不可思议的贡献，而突然之间，有一半的网络或一半的国家再也无法忍受他们了。

sentences.en: They don't want to see their face anymore because of blah, blah, blah, blah, blah.
sentences.zh: 因为这样或那样的原因，他们再也不想看到这些演员的脸了。

sentences.en: And I get so upset for those people, those actors, and it just feels so wrong.
sentences.zh: 我为那些人、那些演员感到非常难过，这感觉太不公平了。

sentences.en: So I don't know.
sentences.zh: 所以，我不知道。

sentences.en: I try to express myself and my politics through my work.
sentences.zh: 我试着通过我的作品来表达我和我的政治观点。

sentences.en: I made a documentary called Bread and Roses about the Taliban retakeover in Afghanistan and Zorofsky vs. Texas about the abortion ban.
sentences.zh: 我制作了一部关于塔利班重新夺回阿富汗政权的纪录片《面包与玫瑰》，还有一部关于堕胎禁令的《佐罗夫斯基诉德克萨斯州案》。

sentences.en: Pretty much a lot of my movies coming out for my production company are expressions of the political landscape.
sentences.zh: 我的制片公司即将上映的很多电影，基本上都是对政治局势的表达。

sentences.en: That's how I feel like I can be helpful.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这样我才能帮上忙。

sentences.en: That's how I feel like I can, I don't know, bring awareness or do something.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这样我才能，我不知道，唤起人们的意识或者做点什么。

sentences.en: Do you regret how you dealt with things before?
sentences.zh: 你后悔以前处理事情的方式吗？

sentences.en: I don't know, probably.
sentences.zh: 我不知道，大概吧。

sentences.en: I mean, I regret everything I've ever done or said, but...
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我做过或说过的一切我都后悔，但是……

sentences.en: Five seconds after you've done or said.
sentences.zh: 在你做过或说过五秒钟之后就会后悔。

sentences.en: Yeah, of course.
sentences.zh: 对，当然。

sentences.en: I'm going to take the zip drives out of all of these cameras when I leave.
sentences.zh: 等我离开的时候，我要把所有这些摄像机里的内存卡都拿走。

sentences.en: It feels, the second term feels different.
sentences.zh: 感觉，第二任期感觉不一样。

sentences.en: Because it's like, we all knew he said what he was going to do.
sentences.zh: 因为就像是，我们都知道他说过他会做什么。

sentences.en: We knew what he did for four years.
sentences.zh: 我们知道他过去四年做了什么。

sentences.en: He was very clear.
sentences.zh: 他非常明确。

sentences.en: And that's what we chose.
sentences.zh: 而这就是我们的选择。

sentences.en: Again.
sentences.zh: 又一次。

sentences.en: I think there's something that just feels different about the second term.
sentences.zh: 我觉得对于第二任期，有些事情感觉就是不一样。

sentences.en: I want to thank you for being so thoughtful.
sentences.zh: 我要感谢你如此用心。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你。

sentences.zh: 谢谢邀请我来。
